advisories.reason: ReDoS in picomatch's extglob handling, high, affecting every version through 4.0.7 with no patched release yet. Only dev tooling installs it (vite, vitest, tinyglobby, fdir and lint-staged), and they match patterns from this repository's own config, never input from users. npm audit --omit=dev finds nothing in the root or functions trees. When a fixed picomatch is published, add an overrides entry and delete this one.
